brief:
Australia imposed sanctions on three settlers and four settler organizations over settlement expansion and violent attacks against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, the Shehab Wire reported. The measures target individuals and groups involved in what Australia characterized as illegal settlement activities and assaults on Palestinian civilians.

The sanctions represent a rare Western measure against Israeli settlers, though Australia has not detailed the specific individuals or organizations targeted or the mechanisms of the penalties.

title: Australia sanctions settlers and settler organizations for West Bank violence
